rows.ARS:
Mauve or mauve blend Large-Flowered Climber.
Exhibition name: Perennial Blue ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Bernard F. Mehring (United Kingdom).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Eurosa in 2003 as 'Perennial Blue'.
Introduced in United States by Ashdown Roses Historic Archive in 2007 as 'Perennial Blue'.
rows.Bloom: Mauve or purple blend. Mild, sweet fragrance. Small, semi-double (9-16 petals), in large clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Tall, climbing. Medium, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: up to 8'2" (up to 250cm).
